forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove credential from code. Use IAM Roles or AWS Secrets Manager. Revoke the exposed key in the AWS console immediately.

forbidden_patterns.reason: STIG V-222645: Weak hashing algorithm (MD5) detected. Not FIPS 140-3 compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace MD5 with a FIPS-compliant algorithm such as SHA-256 (hashlib.sha256()).

forbidden_patterns.reason: STIG V-222645 / NIST SP 800-131A: Weak hashing algorithm (SHA-1) detected. Not FIPS 140-3 compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace SHA-1 with a FIPS-compliant algorithm such as SHA-256 (hashlib.sha256()).

forbidden_patterns.reason: STIG V-222643: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 are deprecated and forbidden.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Upgrade to TLS 1.2 (ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT with minimum version set to TLSv1.2) or TLS 1.3.
